actor.sampling: fresh independent agent action per trajectory per step; frozen state/commanded-goal policy
actor.evaluation_overlap: actor originally trained on all source episodes; ETT validation is not held out for actor

dataset_split.reference: historical full-source split restricted to expert

duplicate_trajectory_audit.definition: byte-identical complete selected (state, action, next_state, goal) trajectories

reward: 1[newest XY distance to fixed goal < 2.0]; repeat reward, no goal termination
reward_justification: fixed reward region and all absorbing swamp cells are disjoint; not a general reward reconstruction
objective: L_diag + lambda * mean(sum_t 0.95**t r(s_next)), lambda=1, minimized; exactly two losses
selection: final iteration only; monitor never selects or tunes
perturbations: iid N(0,I4), using columns 2:6 of original seed-matched N(0,I6) draws
search_geometry_caveat: Removing bias dimensions changes perturbation geometry and update-norm clipping; not isolation of every optimization effect
